name: Corrupted Blessing
source:
Corrupted Blessing tells a tale of a young demon named Achmetha, who is going to the overworld for the first time in his life to seek for his missing big brother Amanaki. On Achme’s journey, he meets a young demon Lilian who hears a voice in her head, and a demon hunter human Vladimir. 

[From [url=http://possumato.deviantart.com/art/Corrupted-Blessing-Chapter-1-Update-543825848]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
《腐化的祝福》讲述了一个名叫阿克梅萨的年轻恶魔的故事，他有生以来第一次前往主世界寻找失踪的哥哥阿玛纳基。在阿赫梅的旅程中，他遇到了年轻的恶魔莉莉安（她听到脑海中有个声音）和恶魔猎手人类弗拉基米尔。

[来自[url=http://possumato.deviantart.com/art/Corrupted-Blessing-Chapter-1-Update-543825848]DeviantArt[/url]]
